cases.name: empty
cases.html:
Slack import

Move this workspace from Slack Pro to Smartfire: create an internal Slack app, connect it, dry-run the migration, then import. Full guide in docs/slack-import.md.

1. Create the Slack app

Create an internal app from this manifest, then copy its Client ID and Client Secret below.

  1. Open api.slack.com/apps and choose Create New App → From a manifest.
  2. Pick the Slack workspace, paste the manifest, and create the app.
  3. Open Basic Information and copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
{
  "display_information": {
    "name": "Smartfire Import"
  },
  "settings": {
    "org_deploy_enabled": false
  },
  "oauth_config": {
    "redirect_urls": [
      "http://example.org/slack/oauth/callback"
    ],
    "scopes": {
      "user": [
        "channels:history",
        "channels:read",
        "groups:history",
        "groups:read",
        "im:history",
        "im:read",
        "mpim:history",
        "mpim:read",
        "users:read",
        "users:read.email",
        "team:read"
      ]
    }
  }
}

2. Save credentials

Paste the Client ID and Client Secret from the app's Basic Information page.

3. Connect your Slack account

Connect with your Slack account. The workspace import runs as you: it reads every public channel plus the private channels you are in.

Connect Slack

4. Dry run and import

Finish steps 2 and 3 first: the dry run needs saved credentials and your connected Slack account.

All import runs
